structure.description: Two sentences: Paraphrase the question and give your answer.
Detailed point or side A of the argument.
Another point or side B of the argument.
One sentence summarizing the main point.

faq.question: Can I use 'I' in the essay?
faq.answer: Yes, if the question asks for your opinion.

faq.question: How many words should I write?
faq.answer: Aim for 260-280 words to ensure quality without running out of time.
